assumptions: ChatGPT export format based on known exports: conversations.json (or conversations-NNN.json) with a mapping tree and current_node. Not yet tested against a real 2026 export.

Kept content types: text, multimodal_text (images -> [image]), code (fenced), execution_output, tether_quote, tether_browsing_display, system_error. Thoughts, reasoning recaps, custom instructions and memory are left out.
Tool output is cut to 4000 characters.
Chats with no visible messages are skipped and reported, not stored.
Run the acceptance import command with CONTEXTOS_HOME set to a temporary folder, so made-up chats do not enter the real database.
New importers follow the same shape: read_export(path) -> ParsedExport, plus a command under `contextos import`.
